name: SnapLogo
description: Logo Making App from scratch using React and Tailwind CSS

paragraphs: A clean, fast, browser-based logo creator. Pick an icon, customize colors and geometry, and download a crisp PNG — no account, no backend, no friction.

Snap Logo is a lightweight, fully client-side logo design tool built with React and Vite. It lets you compose a logo from a large library of vector icons (powered by Lucide), tweak its geometry and color, and export a high-resolution PNG — all in a single browser session with no sign-up required.
All settings are persisted automatically to localStorage, so your work survives a page refresh.
features: Icon Library — Hundreds of outline vector icons via Lucide React, plus optional colored PNG illustrations from an external source
Icon Editor — Control size, rotation, and color (including gradient fills) of the icon
Background Editor — Set background color or gradient, canvas padding, and corner rounding
Live Preview — Real-time canvas preview with a blueprint grid workspace
Zoom Controls — Zoom In / Zoom Out / Reset directly on the canvas
